prerequisites: Two independent authenticated EVE characters A/B in same real solar system
Disposable world and intact SQLite/GameStore storage; never touch evejs-data
Current player mining Chat24 integration verified
Chat01 integration of three default-OFF source hooks and coopPlayerOreReprocessing module
Native reprocessing facility with at least one true zero-ISK-cost SDE ore quote

steps.action: A locates real asteroid and completes mining cycle
verify: Native resource source decreases by exact material amount
Source ore itemID appears only in A physical ship hold
No second player receives free ore

steps.action: A jettisons original mined ore from stock ship hold to physical jetcan
verify: One native space container ID/position
Original ore itemIDs move from ship into can; any split has original stackOriginID
Only original amounts and owner; no phantom can counted as delivery

steps.action: B opens same physical jetcan and legally takes ore into native permitted hold
verify: Original can contents decrease exactly by B pickup
Native fleet membership alone does not authorize illegal transfer
B hold capacity and specialized hold flags enforced
Owner, location and quantities match native itemStore; A cannot retain duplicates

steps.action: B physically docks at native station
verify: B server session dockedLocationID matches station
No ore changes location from ship merely because warp finished

steps.action: B transfers ore to personal station HANGAR through native invBroker
verify: Real itemIDs or valid native split origins
B owns items, station location and HANGAR flag
No cargo remains duplicated in B ship

steps.action: B optionally compresses selected stack via native facility UI
verify: Compressed typeID is authentic native SDE mapping
Same native itemID and exact input/output quantity per native compression receipt
No bypass of capacity or owner restrictions

steps.action: B requests true native SDE reprocessing quote for ONE available personal-hangar ore stack
verify: Actual native quote identifies type, portions, consumed quantity, remainder and material outputs
If positive ISK wallet debit required, transaction must refuse before mutation
No randomized or multiple input stacks accepted by opt-in path

steps.action: B starts opt-in native reprocessing; inject crash after fsynced PREPARED receipt and before item mutation
verify: Persistent PREPARED exists
No ore consumed or minerals credited
Retry fails closed and does not create second mutation

steps.action: Restore disposable fixture and inject crash after native items-table flush before COMMITTED receipt
verify: Ore source changed exactly once
New material itemIDs and amounts match original native SDE quote
Operator authorizes read-only reconciliation and sees original itemIDs
No second debit or extra minerals

steps.action: Complete one native zero-fee reprocessing transaction and reconnect both clients
verify: COMMITTED receipt and independent GameStore inventory agree
Player B owns all output material itemIDs at actual station
Original ore leftover exact; no phantom ISK charge
Same request cannot grant twice

steps.action: B optionally transfers materials to A only using permitted native owner/location transaction
verify: No unauthorized owner reassignment
Source/destination real itemIDs and net quantities reconcile after restart

restartGate.afterEveryStep: Cold restart EveJS and reconnect BOTH independent EVE clients; verify GameStore SQLite, character wallets and original itemIDs, not UI-only caches
restartGate.unknownOutcome: NEEDS_OPERATOR_RECONCILIATION; never replay native mutations without exact proof
